rationale: Marginal ordinal alignment collapsed to depth-only kernels and lost the observed joint-feature benefit. Learn the complementary correction from errors made on held-out training animals, rather than from marginal label alignment or in-sample teacher confidence.
base: DINOv2 frozen depth global descriptor with the same validation-selected RBF SVR as foundation_pooling_v1
residual_targets: For each training animal group, refit the base on all other training animals using fixed inner-validation-selected base hyperparameters; predict every episode in that left-out group. Residual = true BCS minus that held-group base prediction. The validation and test animals never enter these fits.
correction: A separate RBF SVR predicts residuals from RGB-only, depth-only, concatenated RGBD, or a product-kernel RGBD representation. Final score = clip(base_depth + lambda * correction, 2,6). Depth remains required at inference; no RGB-only deployment claim.
selection: All correction settings selected by inner-validation MAE; exact ties retain earlier grid point. Lambda=0 explicitly permits fallback to the base if no correction validates.
controls: Same-modality correction; in-sample residual correction; fixed shuffled residual labels; one-parameter median validation-bias correction; compare against same-encoder depth-only and direct RGBD SVR
scope: Application-specific cross-animal residual fusion built on established stacked generalisation; no claim to invent out-of-fold stacking. These source results remain exploratory after previous tests were observed.
